blocks.text: Frazali fe'l: ikki so'z — bitta ma'no

Frazali fe'l (phrasal verb) — fe'l va kichik so'z birikmasi: **in**, **out**, **on**, **off**, **up**, **down**, **away**, **back**, **over**, **round**, **through**. Asoslari qizil kitobda o'tilgan: to'ldiruvchisiz fe'llar (→ qizil kitob, 114-dars), to'ldiruvchi va olmoshning o'rni (→ qizil kitob, 115-dars), eng ko'p ishlatiladiganlari ro'yxati (→ qizil kitob, 121–122-darslar). Bu bo'limda (137–145-darslar) bir qadam oldinga boramiz: har bir kichik so'zning **umumiy ma'nosi**, bitta frazali fe'lning bir necha ma'nosi, o'xshash fe'llar orasidagi farq va so'z tartibining qiyin holatlari.

O'zbek tilida bunga eng yaqin hodisa — **ko'makchi fe'l**: yozib **olmoq**, yirtib **tashlamoq**, o'qib **chiqmoq**, qochib **ketmoq**, qaytib **kelmoq**. Ikkinchi fe'l asosiy fe'lga yo'nalish, tugallik yoki davomiylik qo'shadi — inglizchada bu vazifani kichik so'z bajaradi: write **down** — yozib **olmoq**, tear **up** — yirtib **tashlamoq**, run **away** — qochib **ketmoq**. Bu moslik har doim ham ishlamaydi, lekin notanish frazali fe'lning ma'nosini taxmin qilishda katta yordam beradi.

Frazali fe'llarni ma'nosi qanchalik «shaffof»ligiga qarab uch guruhga bo'lish mumkin. **1)** Kichik so'z oddiy **yo'nalish**ni bildiradi — ma'noni qismlardan topish oson: climb **up**, jump **off**, walk **out**. **2)** Kichik so'z fe'lga **tugallik**, **davomiylik** yoki **kuchayish** qo'shadi: eat **up** (yeb bo'lmoq), read **on** (o'qishda davom etmoq), slow **down** (sekinlashmoq). **3)** **Idioma** — ma'noni qismlardan topib bo'lmaydi: take **after** (o'xshamoq), put **up with** (chidamoq), turn **up** (kelmoq). Uchinchi guruhni yangi so'z kabi yodlash kerak.

rows: tirmashib chiqmoq, sakrab tushmoq, chiqib ketmoq
yeb bitirmoq, yirtib tashlamoq, yonib kul bo'lmoq

items.text: The cat **climbed up** the tree and refused to come down.
items.translation: Mushuk daraxtga **tirmashib chiqdi**-yu, pastga tushgisi kelmadi.

items.text: Finish your soup — you need to **eat** it all **up**.
Emma **takes after** her father: she's calm and very patient.
items.translation: Emma **otasiga tortgan**: xotirjam va juda sabrli.

blocks.text: Kichik so'zlar tasodifiy emas: har birining bir nechta **asosiy ma'nosi** bor va ular yuzlab frazali fe'llarda takrorlanadi. Masalan, **out** «tashqariga» bo'lishidan tashqari «butunlay, oxirigacha» (sell out, wear out) va «yo'qolish, o'chish» (die out, go out) ni ham bildiradi. Bu ma'nolarni bilsangiz, notanish frazali fe'lni ko'pincha kontekstdan taxmin qila olasiz. Quyidagi jadval — keyingi darslarning «xaritasi».

items.text: The concert **sold out** in two hours, so we didn't get tickets.
items.translation: Konsert chiptalari ikki soatda **sotilib tugadi**, shuning uchun bizga chipta tegmadi.

items.text: Prices **went up** again this month, but our salaries stayed the same.
items.translation: Bu oy narxlar yana **oshdi**, maoshlarimiz esa o'sha-o'sha.

items.text: The noise of the traffic slowly **faded away** as we climbed higher.
items.translation: Yuqoriga ko'tarilganimiz sari mashinalar shovqini asta-sekin **so'nib ketdi**.

blocks.text: Bitta frazali fe'l — bir nechta ma'no

Ko'p frazali fe'l **bir nechta ma'no**ga ega va to'g'ri ma'no faqat kontekstdan aniqlanadi. O'zbeklar uchun eng katta qiyinchilik shu: lug'atdagi birinchi ma'noni olib, gapni noto'g'ri tushunish. Shuning uchun frazali fe'lni alohida emas, **tipik to'ldiruvchi yoki ega bilan birga** yodlang: take off **your coat** / **the plane** took off / **her career** took off.

items.text: Her online business **took off** after a famous blogger mentioned it.
items.translation: Mashhur bloger tilga olganidan keyin uning onlayn biznesi **birdan rivojlanib ketdi**.

items.text: Jasur **picked up** quite a lot of Turkish while working in Istanbul.
items.translation: Jasur Istanbulda ishlab yurganida turk tilini ancha **o'rganib oldi**.

items.text: Women **make up** sixty per cent of the students on this course.
items.translation: Bu kursdagi talabalarning oltmish foizini ayollar **tashkil qiladi**.

blocks.text: So'z tartibi frazali fe'lning turiga bog'liq. **1) To'ldiruvchisiz**: The car **broke down**. **2) Ajraladigan** (separable): ot kichik so'zdan oldin ham, keyin ham turadi — turn **down** the offer / turn the offer **down**; olmosh esa faqat o'rtada — turn **it** down (→ qizil kitob, 115-dars). **3) Ajralmaydigan** (inseparable): to'ldiruvchi — ot ham, olmosh ham — doim kichik so'zdan **keyin**: look **after** her, get **over** it, come **across** it. **4) Uch qismli**: fe'l + kichik so'z + predlog, to'ldiruvchi eng oxirida: put up **with** him, run out **of** it.

rows: get up, turn up, set off
put off, call off, give back
get over, come across, run into, go through
look forward to, get on with, cut down on

blocks.text: Ajraladimi yoki yo'qmi — qanday bilish mumkin? Lug'at yordam beradi: «**turn sth down**» deb yozilgan bo'lsa (sth = something, sb = somebody), to'ldiruvchi o'rtaga kira oladi; «**look after sb**» deb yozilgan bo'lsa — faqat oxirida. Uzun to'ldiruvchi esa ajraladigan fe'lda ham odatda oxirga qo'yiladi: She **turned down** the job that her uncle had offered her in London.

items.text: My grandmother **looked after** us whenever our parents were away.
items.translation: Ota-onamiz yo'q paytlarda bizga doim buvim **qarardi**.

items.text: It took Nilufar a month to **get over** the flu, and she still feels weak.
items.translation: Nilufar grippdan **tuzalib ketishi** uchun bir oy kerak bo'ldi, hali ham holsiz.

items.text: The offer was generous, but Bekzod **turned it down** without a second thought.
items.translation: Taklif saxiy edi, lekin Bekzod uni o'ylab ham o'tirmay **rad etdi**.

blocks.text: Frazali fe'llar so'zlashuv va oddiy yozuvda tabiiy. Rasmiy matnda (ariza, hisobot, ilmiy maqola) ko'pincha lotin tilidan kirgan bitta fe'l ishlatiladi. Ikkalasini ham bilish kerak: yangiliklarda **postpone** ham, **put off** ham uchraydi. Do'st bilan gaplashganda rasmiy fe'l g'alati eshitiladi («Let's postpone our walk»), rasmiy xatda esa frazali fe'l haddan tashqari «yengil» ko'rinishi mumkin.

Frazali fe'ldan ko'pincha **ot** ham yasaladi — u qo'shib yoki chiziqcha bilan yoziladi: break down → a **breakdown** (buzilish; asabiy tushkunlik), check in → **check-in** (ro'yxatdan o'tish joyi), work out → a **workout** (mashg'ulot), take off → **take-off** (havoga ko'tarilish), set back → a **setback** (to'siq, orqaga ketish), turn out → **turnout** (qatnashchilar soni). Fe'l — ikki so'z, ot — bitta: Our car **broke down** (fe'l) / We had a **breakdown** on the motorway (ot).

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I came it across» → I **came across** it (ajralmaydigan fe'l — olmosh oxirida); «They turned down him» → They **turned him down**; «She looks after very well» → kimga? **look after** to'ldiruvchisiz ishlatilmaydi: She **looks after** her grandmother very well; «return back» → **come back** yoki **return** (ikkalasi birga emas); lug'atdagi birinchi ma'noni olish — «Sales picked up» «savdo ko'tarib olindi» emas, «savdo **jonlandi**»; rasmiy xatda «I want to find out about the course» o'rniga — I would like to **learn** more about the course.

Yangi frazali fe'lni uchratganda uch savol bering: 1) kichik so'zning qaysi ma'nosi ishlayapti (yo'nalish, tugallik, davom, yo'qolish)? 2) to'ldiruvchi bormi va olmosh qayerda turadi? 3) o'zbekchada qaysi ko'makchi fe'l mos keladi (`-ib olmoq`, `-ib tashlamoq`, `-ib ketmoq`)? Daftarga fe'lning o'zini emas, butun iborani yozing: «**set up** a company», «**run out of** time».

Bo'lim rejasi: in / out → 138-dars, out → 139-dars, on / off → 140–141-darslar, up / down → 142-dars, up → 143–144-darslar, away / back → 145-dars. Fe'l + predlog (look at, depend on, believe in) frazali fe'l emas — ular 132–136-darslarda.

items: Frazali fe'l = fe'l + kichik so'z (+ ba'zan predlog); ma'nosi oddiy yo'nalishdan to'liq idiomagacha bo'ladi.
Kichik so'zning umumiy ma'nosi bor: **out** — butunlay / yo'qolish, **up** — ko'payish / tugallik, **off** — ajralish / bekor qilish, **on** — davom, **away** — uzoqlashish, **back** — qaytish.
Bitta frazali fe'l bir necha ma'noli bo'ladi: to'g'ri ma'noni kontekst va to'ldiruvchi ko'rsatadi.
Ajraladigan fe'lda olmosh o'rtada (**turn it down**), ajralmaydigan va uch qismli fe'lda — oxirida (**look after it**, **put up with it**).
Rasmiy matnda ko'pincha bitta fe'l: put off → postpone, find out → discover; frazali fe'ldan ot ham yasaladi: a breakdown, a workout.

examples.title: Literal meaning: direction and movement
examples.description: Kichik so'z oddiy yo'nalishni bildiradi: tepaga, pastga, ichkariga, tashqariga, nariga. O'zbekchada bunga «-ib chiqmoq», «-ib tushmoq», «-ib ketmoq» mos keladi.

sentences.text: The lift wasn't working, so we **walked up** to the ninth floor.
sentences.translation: Lift ishlamayotgan edi, shuning uchun to'qqizinchi qavatga **piyoda chiqdik**.

sentences.text: When the bus stopped suddenly, a box **fell off** the shelf above my head.
sentences.translation: Avtobus to'satdan to'xtaganda, boshim ustidagi tokchadan bir quti **tushib ketdi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod opened the window and **leaned out** to see who was shouting.
sentences.translation: Bekzod derazani ochdi va kim baqirayotganini ko'rish uchun **boshini chiqardi**.

sentences.text: **Stand back** from the edge of the platform until the train stops.
sentences.translation: Poyezd to'xtaguncha platforma chetidan **nariroq turing**.

sentences.text: Halfway through the film, two people got up and **walked out**.
sentences.translation: Filmning yarmida ikki kishi o'rnidan turib, **chiqib ketdi**.

sentences.text: The thieves **climbed in** through the bathroom window while the family was asleep.
sentences.translation: Oila uxlab yotganda o'g'rilar hammom derazasidan **tirmashib kirishdi**.

sentences.text: Could you **turn round**? I want to see the back of the dress.
sentences.translation: Bir **o'girilib** turolasizmi? Ko'ylakning orqasini ko'rmoqchiman.

sentences.text: As soon as the doors opened, the children **rushed out** into the playground.
sentences.translation: Eshiklar ochilishi bilan bolalar o'yin maydonchasiga **yugurib chiqishdi**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **jumped in** first, and the lake was colder than she expected.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza birinchi bo'lib suvga **sakrab tushdi**, ko'l u kutganidan ham sovuq ekan.

sentences.text: The cat **climbed down** from the roof only when we put some food on the ground.
sentences.translation: Yerga ovqat qo'yganimizdan keyingina mushuk tomdan **tushib keldi**.

examples.title: The particle adds meaning: finishing and continuing
examples.description: Kichik so'z yo'nalishni emas, harakatning natijasi yoki davomini bildiradi: **up** / **down** / **out** — oxirigacha, butunlay («-ib bo'lmoq», «-ib tashlamoq»); **on** — davom etish («-(y)ver-»).

sentences.text: The children were so hungry that they **ate up** everything on the table.
sentences.translation: Bolalar shunchalik och ediki, stoldagi hamma narsani **yeb bitirishdi**.

sentences.text: **Drink up**, everyone — the café is closing in five minutes.
sentences.translation: Hammangiz **ichib bo'linglar** — kafe besh daqiqadan keyin yopiladi.

sentences.text: Kate was so angry that she **tore up** the letter without reading it.
sentences.translation: Keytning jahli chiqqanidan xatni o'qimasdan **yirtib tashladi**.

sentences.text: The old cinema in our town **burned down** last winter, and nobody knows why.
sentences.translation: Shahrimizdagi eski kinoteatr o'tgan qish **yonib kul bo'ldi**, sababini hech kim bilmaydi.

sentences.text: These trainers are only a year old, but they've already **worn out**.
sentences.translation: Bu krossovkalarga endigina bir yil bo'ldi, lekin allaqachon **yeyilib ketdi**.

sentences.text: Don't stop now — **read on**, the best part of the story is coming.
sentences.translation: Hozir to'xtama — **o'qiyver**, hikoyaning eng qiziq joyi kelyapti.

sentences.text: After a short pause, the speaker **carried on** with her presentation.
sentences.translation: Qisqa tanaffusdan keyin ma'ruzachi taqdimotini **davom ettirdi**.

sentences.text: Jasur **wrote down** every word the doctor said, so he wouldn't forget anything.
sentences.translation: Hech narsani unutmaslik uchun Jasur shifokorning har bir so'zini **yozib oldi**.

sentences.text: We **used up** all the hot water, so Dad had to have a cold shower.
sentences.translation: Hamma issiq suvni **ishlatib tugatdik**, shuning uchun dadam sovuq dush qabul qilishga majbur bo'ldi.

sentences.text: If you **keep on** practising every day, you'll see real progress by the summer.
sentences.translation: Har kuni mashq qilishda **davom etsangiz**, yozgacha haqiqiy natijani ko'rasiz.

examples.title: Idiomatic meaning: learn them as new words
examples.description: Ma'noni qismlardan topib bo'lmaydi: **take after** (o'xshamoq), **turn up** (kelmoq), **come across** (tasodifan topmoq), **put up with** (chidamoq), **look into** (tekshirmoq), **get by** (amallab kun ko'rmoq), **bring up** (gap ochmoq).

sentences.text: Madina **takes after** her grandmother — they even laugh the same way.
sentences.translation: Madina **buvisiga tortgan** — hatto bir xil kulishadi.

sentences.text: We waited all morning, but the plumber never **turned up**.
sentences.translation: Ertalabdan beri kutdik, lekin santexnik **kelmadi**.

sentences.text: While tidying the attic, Oliver **came across** some old photos of his parents.
sentences.translation: Chordoqni yig'ishtirayotib Oliver ota-onasining eski suratlarini **topib qoldi**.

sentences.text: How do you **put up with** a flatmate who never washes the dishes?
sentences.translation: Hech qachon idish yuvmaydigan xonadoshga qanday **chidaysiz**?

sentences.text: The bank promised to **look into** the problem with my card.
sentences.translation: Bank kartam bilan bog'liq muammoni **tekshirib ko'rishga** va'da berdi.

sentences.text: Students in London often **get by** on very little money.
sentences.translation: Londondagi talabalar ko'pincha juda oz pul bilan **kun ko'rishadi**.

sentences.text: Please don't **bring up** politics at dinner — Uncle James gets angry very quickly.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, dasturxon atrofida siyosat haqida **gap ochmang** — Jeyms amakining jahli tez chiqadi.

sentences.text: That story sounds too perfect — I think he **made** it **up**.
sentences.translation: Bu hikoya juda silliq — menimcha, u uni **to'qib chiqargan**.

sentences.text: When Aziz **ran into** an old classmate at the airport, they talked for an hour.
sentences.translation: Aziz aeroportda eski sinfdoshini **uchratib qolganida**, ular bir soat gaplashishdi.

sentences.text: The new manager **looks down on** anyone without a university degree.
sentences.translation: Yangi menejer oliy ma'lumoti yo'q har qanday odamga **past nazar bilan qaraydi**.

examples.title: One verb, several meanings: **take off**, **pick up**
examples.description: Bitta frazali fe'l kontekstga qarab har xil ma'no beradi: **take off**, **pick up**, **go off**, **work out**, **make up**. Juft gaplarda solishtiring.

sentences.text: **Take off** your muddy boots, please — I've just washed the floor.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, loy etiklaringni **yech** — polni hozirgina yuvdim.

sentences.text: Our flight to Edinburgh **took off** forty minutes late because of fog.
sentences.translation: Edinburgga reysimiz tuman tufayli qirq daqiqa kechikib **havoga ko'tarildi**.

sentences.text: After her first song went viral, Kate's career really **took off**.
sentences.translation: Birinchi qo'shig'i internetda tarqalgach, Keytning karyerasi rosa **yuksalib ketdi**.

sentences.text: Nilufar's husband **picks** her **up** from the office every evening.
sentences.translation: Nilufarni har kuni kechqurun eri ofisdan **olib ketadi**.

sentences.text: Tom never studied Spanish; he just **picked** it **up** while living in Madrid.
sentences.translation: Tom ispan tilini hech qachon o'qimagan, Madridda yashab yurib **o'rganib olgan**.

sentences.text: The smoke alarm **went off** because someone had burnt the toast.
sentences.translation: Kimdir tostni kuydirib qo'ygani uchun tutun signali **chalinib ketdi**.

sentences.text: Don't eat that chicken — I think it's **gone off**.
sentences.translation: U tovuqni yema — menimcha, **aynib qolgan**.

sentences.text: I **work out** three times a week at the gym near my office.
sentences.translation: Ofisim yaqinidagi sport zalida haftasiga uch marta **shug'ullanaman**.

sentences.text: It took us an hour to **work out** how to use the new printer.
sentences.translation: Yangi printerdan qanday foydalanishni **tushunib olishimizga** bir soat ketdi.

sentences.text: Bekzod and his brother argued all morning but **made up** before lunch.
sentences.translation: Bekzod akasi bilan ertalabdan beri tortishdi, lekin tushlikdan oldin **yarashib olishdi**.

examples.title: Separable verbs: **turn it down**, not turn down it
examples.description: Ajraladigan frazali fe'l: ot kichik so'zdan oldin ham, keyin ham keladi; olmosh (it, them, him, her) faqat o'rtada. Uzun to'ldiruvchi odatda oxirida turadi.

sentences.text: The company offered James a job in Manchester, but he **turned it down**.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya Jeymsga Manchesterdan ish taklif qildi, lekin u **rad etdi**.

sentences.text: If you don't understand the contract, **talk it over** with a lawyer before you sign.
sentences.translation: Shartnomani tushunmasangiz, imzolashdan oldin uni advokat bilan **muhokama qiling**.

sentences.text: Could you **turn** the heating **down** a little? It's like a sauna in here.
sentences.translation: Isitishni biroz **pasaytira olasizmi**? Bu yer xuddi saunaga o'xshaydi.

sentences.text: We had to **put off** the meeting because half the team was ill.
sentences.translation: Jamoaning yarmi kasal bo'lgani uchun yig'ilishni **keyinga qoldirishga** majbur bo'ldik.

sentences.text: Madina lent me her laptop, so I must **give it back** before Friday.
sentences.translation: Madina menga noutbukini berib turdi, juma kunidan oldin uni **qaytarib berishim** kerak.

sentences.text: Don't **throw away** the box — we'll need it if the phone has to go back.
sentences.translation: Qutini **tashlab yuborma** — telefonni qaytarishga to'g'ri kelsa, kerak bo'ladi.

sentences.text: The receptionist **filled in** all the forms that the new patients had brought.
sentences.translation: Qabulxona xodimi yangi bemorlar olib kelgan barcha anketalarni **to'ldirib chiqdi**.

sentences.text: The kids are finally asleep, so try not to **wake them up** when you come in.
sentences.translation: Bolalar nihoyat uxlab qolishdi, kirganingda ularni **uyg'otib yubormaslikka** harakat qil.

sentences.text: Where are the car keys? — I **put them away** in the drawer by the door.
sentences.translation: Mashina kalitlari qani? — Ularni eshik yonidagi tortmaga **olib qo'ydim**.

sentences.text: Jasur **switched** his phone **off** during the exam, as the rules required.
sentences.translation: Qoidaga ko'ra, Jasur imtihon vaqtida telefonini **o'chirib qo'ydi**.

examples.title: Inseparable and three-part verbs: **look after it**
examples.description: Ajralmaydigan fe'llarda (look after, get over, go through, go over) va uch qismli fe'llarda (put up with, look forward to, cut down on) to'ldiruvchi — olmosh ham — doim oxirida turadi.

sentences.text: Who will **look after** your cat while you're in Samarkand?
sentences.translation: Samarqandda bo'lganingizda mushukingizga kim **qaraydi**?

sentences.text: It was a painful break-up, and it took Kate a year to **get over** it.
sentences.translation: Bu og'riqli ajralish edi, Keyt undan **o'ziga kelishi** uchun bir yil kerak bo'ldi.

sentences.text: The customs officer **went through** my suitcase very carefully.
sentences.translation: Bojxona xodimi chamadonimni juda sinchiklab **titkilab chiqdi**.

sentences.text: Let's **go over** the plan once more before the clients arrive.
sentences.translation: Mijozlar kelishidan oldin rejani yana bir bor **ko'rib chiqaylik**.

sentences.text: Our neighbours play loud music, but we've learned to **put up with** it.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilarimiz baland musiqa qo'yishadi, lekin biz bunga **chidashni** o'rgandik.

sentences.text: The students are **looking forward to** the field trip to Khiva next month.
sentences.translation: Talabalar kelasi oydagi Xivaga ilmiy safarni **intiqlik bilan kutishyapti**.

sentences.text: My doctor told me to **cut down on** salt and sugar.
sentences.translation: Shifokorim tuz va shakarni **kamaytirishimni** aytdi.

sentences.text: Emma missed two weeks of school and is now trying to **catch up with** her classmates.
sentences.translation: Emma ikki hafta maktabga bormadi va endi sinfdoshlariga **yetib olishga** harakat qilyapti.

sentences.text: How do you **get on with** your new boss? — Very well, actually.
sentences.translation: Yangi boshlig'ingiz bilan qanday **chiqishyapsiz**? — Aslida, juda yaxshi.

sentences.text: Aziz **came up with** a clever way to save money on our holiday.
sentences.translation: Aziz ta'tilimizda pul tejashning aqlli yo'lini **o'ylab topdi**.

examples.title: Phrasal verbs in the news
examples.description: Yangiliklar va rasmiy vaziyatlar: **look into**, **set up**, **carry out**, **call off**, **go up**, **break out**, **bring in**, **turn out**, **break down**. Tarjimada rasmiyroq o'zbekcha fe'llar.

sentences.text: Police are **looking into** the cause of the fire at the warehouse.
sentences.translation: Politsiya ombordagi yong'in sababini **tekshirmoqda**.

sentences.text: The government plans to **set up** fifty new schools in rural areas.
sentences.translation: Hukumat qishloq hududlarida ellikta yangi maktab **ochishni** rejalashtirmoqda.

sentences.text: Scientists **carried out** a study of two thousand teenagers in Scotland.
sentences.translation: Olimlar Shotlandiyada ikki ming nafar o'smir o'rtasida tadqiqot **o'tkazishdi**.

sentences.text: The final match was **called off** at the last moment because of heavy snow.
sentences.translation: Final o'yini kuchli qor tufayli so'nggi lahzada **bekor qilindi**.

sentences.text: Petrol prices **went up** by ten per cent last month.
sentences.translation: O'tgan oy benzin narxi o'n foizga **oshdi**.

sentences.text: A fire **broke out** on the third floor of the hospital late last night.
sentences.translation: Kecha kechqurun kasalxonaning uchinchi qavatida yong'in **chiqdi**.

sentences.text: Next year the city is **bringing in** new rules for electric scooters.
sentences.translation: Kelasi yildan shahar elektr samokatlar uchun yangi qoidalar **joriy qilyapti**.

sentences.text: Thousands of fans **turned out** to welcome the team at Tashkent airport.
sentences.translation: Jamoani Toshkent aeroportida kutib olish uchun minglab muxlislar **yig'ildi**.

sentences.text: Talks between the two companies **broke down** after the second day.
sentences.translation: Ikki kompaniya o'rtasidagi muzokaralar ikkinchi kuni **barbod bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: The airline has **put off** the launch of its new route to Fergana until spring.
sentences.translation: Aviakompaniya Farg'onaga yangi yo'nalish ochishni bahorgacha **keyinga surdi**.

examples.title: Dialogue: planning a weekend in Oxford
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: ikki do'st dam olish kunlarini rejalashtiradi — turli turdagi frazali fe'llar (to'ldiruvchisiz, ajraladigan, ajralmaydigan, uch qismli).

sentences.text: — Kate, have you **found out** when the train to Oxford leaves on Saturday?
sentences.translation: — Keyt, shanba kuni Oksfordga poyezd qachon jo'nashini **bilib oldingmi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, I **looked it up** last night: there's one at half past eight.
sentences.translation: — Ha, kecha kechqurun **qarab qo'ydim**: sakkiz yarimda bittasi bor.

sentences.text: — That's early! We'll have to **get up** at six to get to the station.
sentences.translation: — Juda erta-ku! Vokzalga yetib borish uchun oltida **turishimiz** kerak bo'ladi.

sentences.text: — I know, but if we **put it off** until Sunday, it'll rain all day.
sentences.translation: — Bilaman, lekin yakshanbaga **qoldirsak**, kun bo'yi yomg'ir yog'adi.

sentences.text: — Fair enough. Can your brother **look after** the dog while we're away?
sentences.translation: — To'g'ri. Biz yo'q paytda ukang itga **qarab tura oladimi**?

sentences.text: — He can, but we'll have to **pay him back** with a nice dinner.
sentences.translation: — Qaray oladi, lekin buning evaziga uni yaxshi kechki ovqat bilan **siylashimiz** kerak.

sentences.text: — Deal. And let's not **run out of** money this time — we need a budget.
sentences.translation: — Kelishdik. Bu safar pulimiz **tugab qolmasin** — bizga byudjet kerak.

sentences.text: — Good idea. I'll **write down** everything we spend in my phone.
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi fikr. Sarflagan hamma narsamizni telefonimga **yozib boraman**.

sentences.text: — And what time should we **head back** on Sunday evening?
sentences.translation: — Yakshanba kuni kechqurun soat nechada **ortga qaytamiz**?

sentences.text: — Not too late — I need to **catch up on** some work before Monday.
sentences.translation: — Juda kech emas — dushanbagacha orqada qolgan ishlarimni **bitirib olishim** kerak.
